Position Overview
Agiloft is looking for a Demand Generation & Account-Based Marketing Manager to generate qualified pipeline within priority markets, segments, and accounts through integrated demand generation and account-based marketing strategies.
This individual contributor will translate growth priorities into targeted programs that reach the right buyers, activate priority accounts, and create and accelerate pipeline. The role owns campaign strategy and execution across 1:1, 1:few, and 1:many motions, balancing highly personalized account engagement with scalable demand generation approaches.
Working closely with Sales, SDRs, Product Marketing, Partner Marketing, and Marketing Operations, this role will use market intelligence, customer insights, intent signals, performance data, and sales input to determine where and how Agiloft should engage target audiences.
The Demand Generation & ABM Manager will independently make informed decisions about audience segmentation, campaign strategy, channel mix, personalization, testing, and optimization within assigned target markets. This role will orchestrate campaigns across digital, email, events, content, social, partners, sales plays, and other relevant channels.
Data, AI, automation, and marketing technology will support faster research, more relevant personalization, scalable execution, and continuous campaign optimization. Strong human judgment remains essential for translating insights into strategy, evaluating performance, prioritizing opportunities, and determining where investment will have the greatest pipeline impact.
This role will be successful by consistently translating market opportunities into measurable pipeline, improving campaign effectiveness through experimentation and optimization, and creating repeatable approaches that scale successful demand generation and ABM strategies.

Position Overview

Agiloft is looking for a Demand Generation & Account-Based Marketing Manager to generate qualified pipeline within priority markets, segments, and accounts through integrated demand generation and account-based marketing strategies.

This individual contributor will translate growth priorities into targeted programs that reach the right buyers, activate priority accounts, and create and accelerate pipeline. The role owns campaign strategy and execution across 1:1, 1:few, and 1:many motions, balancing highly personalized account engagement with scalable demand generation approaches.

Working closely with Sales, SDRs, Product Marketing, Partner Marketing, and Marketing Operations, this role will use market intelligence, customer insights, intent signals, performance data, and sales input to determine where and how Agiloft should engage target audiences.

The Demand Generation & ABM Manager will independently make informed decisions about audience segmentation, campaign strategy, channel mix, personalization, testing, and optimization within assigned target markets. This role will orchestrate campaigns across digital, email, events, content, social, partners, sales plays, and other relevant channels.

Data, AI, automation, and marketing technology will support faster research, more relevant personalization, scalable execution, and continuous campaign optimization. Strong human judgment remains essential for translating insights into strategy, evaluating performance, prioritizing opportunities, and determining where investment will have the greatest pipeline impact.

This role will be successful by consistently translating market opportunities into measurable pipeline, improving campaign effectiveness through experimentation and optimization, and creating repeatable approaches that scale successful demand generation and ABM strategies.

lists.content:
Pipeline Generation & Market Activation

  • Own integrated demand generation and ABM programs designed to generate qualified pipeline within assigned target markets, segments, industries, and accounts.
  • Translate company growth objectives and market opportunities into campaign strategies across 1:1, 1:few, and 1:many motions.
  • Determine appropriate audiences, campaign approaches, channel mix, offers, and investment priorities using market intelligence and performance signals.
  • Build repeatable frameworks that scale successful account-based strategies into broader industry, segment, and pipeline-generation programs.
  • Partner with Sales and SDR teams to align marketing programs with territories, account priorities, pipeline needs, and opportunities for growth.

    • Account & Audience Strategy

  • Develop a deep understanding of Agiloft's target industries, buyer challenges, buying committees, competitive landscape, and market trends.
  • Research and identify account opportunities, buyer needs, intent signals, and market dynamics using CRM data, AI-enabled tools, third-party data, and Sales insights.
  • Develop segmentation and targeting strategies that prioritize audiences based on business opportunity and likelihood to engage.
  • Determine where personalized experiences can meaningfully influence buyer behavior and where scalable approaches are more appropriate.
  • Partner with Marketing Operations to maintain high-quality target account, audience, and buying-center segmentation.

    • Integrated Campaign Execution & Sales Activation

  • Orchestrate integrated campaigns across relevant channels, including digital advertising, email, webinars, events, content, social media, gifting, partner marketing, and coordinated Sales and SDR plays.
  • Develop campaign briefs, messaging frameworks, promotional copy, landing page and email copy, presentations, sales enablement materials, and other assets required to activate programs.
  • Collaborate with Product Marketing, Partner Marketing, Marketing Operations, Sales, and SDR teams to deliver relevant messaging, content, offers, and buyer experiences.
  • Enable Sales and SDR teams with account insights, campaign follow-up strategies, outbound messaging, talk tracks, and other resources that support effective buyer engagement.
  • Manage campaigns from planning through launch and optimization, balancing speed, quality, strategic alignment, and business impact.

    • Pipeline Performance & Optimization

  • Define and monitor success measures tied to pipeline creation, account progression, opportunity acceleration, revenue impact, and other relevant business outcomes.
  • Use engagement and campaign metrics as diagnostic signals to understand performance and identify opportunities for improvement.
  • Continuously test and optimize audiences, messaging, channels, offers, personalization strategies, and campaign approaches.
  • Partner with Marketing Operations on reporting, attribution, funnel analysis, dashboards, and account-level performance insights.
  • Communicate campaign performance, pipeline impact, learnings, risks, and recommendations clearly to Marketing, Sales, and leadership stakeholders.
  • Leverage AI, automation, and marketing technology to improve research, campaign planning, personalization, execution, analysis, and scalability while applying sound judgment to outputs and recommendations.

    • Other duties as assigned.

• 8+ years of experience in demand generation, growth, performance, digital, field, or related B2B marketing disciplines, including significant experience developing strategic ABM programs.
  • Demonstrated experience generating pipeline through integrated 1:1, 1:few, and 1:many campaigns within B2B technology or similarly complex buying environments.
  • Proven ability to translate business and market opportunities into audience, campaign, channel, and optimization strategies.
  • Strong analytical skills with experience using segmentation, targeting, intent, funnel, pipeline, and performance data to make decisions and improve business outcomes.
  • Experience partnering effectively with Sales and SDR organizations to align priorities and activate coordinated marketing and sales motions.
  • Hands-on experience with CRM and marketing technology platforms such as Salesforce and HubSpot, Marketo, or similar platforms.
  • Experience working with ABM, data, personalization, or buyer-intelligence technologies such as 6sense, Demandbase, Clay, ZoomInfo, Clearbit, Folloze, Qualified, or comparable platforms.
  • Demonstrated proficiency using AI-enabled tools for research, analysis, personalization, content development, and workflow efficiency, with the judgment to validate outputs and apply them appropriately.
  • Strong critical thinking and decision-making skills, including the ability to interpret incomplete or conflicting signals and determine appropriate action.
  • Strong project management and prioritization skills with demonstrated ability to manage multiple programs and stakeholders in a high-growth environment.
  • Excellent written, verbal, and cross-functional communication skills.

    •

• Experience in SaaS, high-growth technology, legal technology, or another industry with complex B2B buying journeys.
  • Experience marketing to multiple members of enterprise buying committees.
  • Experience developing repeatable demand generation frameworks across multiple industries, segments, or markets.
  • Bachelor's degree or equivalent relevant experience; advanced degree is a plus.

Pricing Model Design & Analysis

  • Own the design, maintenance, and continuous improvement of Agiloft's pricing models, including subscription tiers, seat-based, consumption/usage-based, outcome-based, and hybrid structures
  • Build and run monetization experiments in partnership with Finance and the Director of Product GTM; translate what is learned into standard packaging and pricing guidance
  • Coordinate with finance to develop and maintain financial models that forecast revenue impact of pricing changes, new tier introductions, and packaging adjustments across customer segments
  • Analyze key pricing metrics including ASP trends, discounting rates, tier attach rates, and expansion revenue contribution; surface insights and recommendations on a regular cadence

    •  

    Market & Competitive Intelligence

  • Conduct ongoing competitive benchmarking
  • Build and maintain a buyer and segment view across sector, customer profile, enterprise scale, and geography that informs product and pricing decisions
  • Track market shifts, particularly toward consumption and outcome-based models, and translate those signals into actionable recommendations for the Director of Product GTM and CPO
  • Conduct or commission willingness-to-pay research and customer value perception studies to ground pricing decisions in buyer reality

    •  

    Packaging & Entitlement Design

  • Define and optimize product packages, including feature bundling, entitlement logic, upgrade and expansion triggers, in close partnership with Product and Engineering
  • Ensure packaging reflects Agiloft's buyer personas and use cases
  • Build and maintain a packaging decision framework that can be applied consistently as new capabilities are launched
  • Support the Director of Product GTM in designing and executing the Customer One program by providing pricing and packaging context for reference customer engagements

    •  

    Cross-Functional Coordination

  • Serve as the pricing and packaging subject matter expert for internal stakeholders across Finance, Sales, Revenue Operations, Product, Services and the broader GTM team
  • Build pricing playbooks and deal desk guidance for Sales in partnership with the Director of Product GTM and Revenue Operations
  • Support launch readiness for new products and capabilities by ensuring pricing and packaging are defined, documented, and communicated ahead of each launch, and customer feedback is collected, synthesized, and actioned.
  • Prepare analysis, recommendations, and executive-level summaries to support pricing decisions presented to senior leadership
  • Provide product telemetry requirements input to ensure appropriate signals are delivered for packaging and pricing development  
  • Leverage AI-assisted tools to enhance productivity, streamline workflows, and support day-to-day activities

• 4–7+ years of experience in pricing strategy, business analysis, revenue operations, strategy consulting, or a closely related analytical role within B2B SaaS or enterprise software
  • Demonstrated experience designing or significantly contributing to pricing model development, packaging decisions, or monetization strategy, not just reporting on pricing
  • Fluency in financial modeling
  • Highly analytical with a structured approach to problem-solving; you know how to frame a pricing question, identify the right data, and land a clear recommendation
  • Experience conducting or applying competitive and market analysis to inform pricing and positioning decisions
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills; able to translate complex quantitative work into crisp narratives for non-technical stakeholders
  • Comfortable working cross-functionally and managing multiple workstreams

    •

• Experience at a CLM, legal tech, legal operations, or adjacent enterprise software company
  • Exposure to consumption, usage-based, or outcome-based pricing models, especially in transition from pure seat-based SaaS
  • Familiarity with value-based pricing methodology, conjoint analysis, or willingness-to-pay research techniques
  • Experience working with CPQ tools, Salesforce, and BI platforms
  • Prior experience supporting a pricing function build-out or operating in an early-stage pricing discipline

lists.content:
FedRAMP Program Execution

  • Own day-to-day execution of the company side of the FedRAMP program, including milestones, dependencies, risks, deadlines, and internal follow-through.
  • Translate FedRAMP requirements, findings, partner requests, and service-level commitments into clear internal actions with defined owners, due dates, evidence expectations, and acceptance criteria.
  • Maintain an authoritative view of program status and proactively identify work that may threaten assessment, remediation, continuous-monitoring, or other FedRAMP deadlines.
  • Assess overall program readiness and proactively identify systemic gaps in controls, evidence, ownership, processes, or dependencies that could jeopardize FedRAMP objectives
  • Operate independently within established direction by determining required next actions, establishing priorities and deadlines, resolving routine program and ownership issues, and escalating material risks, disputed requirements, risk-acceptance decisions, missed commitments, or matters requiring management, partner, or specialized technical intervention.
  • Leverage approved AI-enabled tools and automation to improve the efficiency and quality of program activities while independently validating outputs against authoritative requirements and program context

    • Evidence, Controls, and Remediation Coordination

  • Coordinate implementation and ongoing operation of organizational and procedural controls retained by the company, including identifying and working with appropriate internal control owners.
  • Coordinate company inputs into partner-managed FedRAMP records, including control narratives, evidence, remediation information, and other required program documentation.
  • Collect and review evidence for completeness, accuracy, relevance, currency, traceability to applicable controls or findings, and consistency with documented FedRAMP and partner requirements before submission.
  • Act as the company-side quality gate for evidence and remediation responses, independently rejecting incomplete or inadequate submissions and requiring correction before external submission while escalating interpretation disputes or questions of external acceptance when appropriate.
  • Track findings from initial assessments, continuous monitoring, and other authorized testing through assignment, remediation, evidence submission, and closure.
  • Establish internal remediation deadlines, with management input as appropriate, based on external deadlines, service-level requirements, risk, and program dependencies.

    • Cross-Functional and Partner Coordination

  • Serve as the primary operational interface with the company’s external FedRAMP infrastructure and compliance partner.
  • Participate in partner-led continuous-monitoring meetings and ensure resulting actions, findings, requests, and decisions are communicated, assigned, tracked, and completed internally.
  • Work closely with Software Engineering and Cloud Engineering to communicate technical compliance requirements, remediation expectations, deadlines, and required evidence without performing the technical remediation directly.
  • Coordinate with Security, IT, Support, Operations, Product, Legal, and leadership on organizational controls, process changes, customer or contractual considerations, and other FedRAMP-related obligations.
  • Drive commitments across teams that do not report directly to the role through clear requirements, follow-through, escalation, and accountability.
  • Engage appropriate technical or functional subject-matter experts when specialized validation is required and ensure their conclusions are reflected in the program record.

    • Scope, Change, and Program Governance

  • Maintain clarity over FedRAMP-in-scope users, systems, workflows, integrations, organizational processes, control inheritance, and shared-responsibility boundaries.
  • Maintain clear understanding of which obligations are retained by the company versus operated, inherited, or evidenced by external partners.
  • Coordinate review of proposed product, infrastructure, operational, or process changes that may affect FedRAMP scope, documented behavior, or control responsibilities.
  • Coordinate delivery and maintenance of required compliant system artifacts, including the approved operating-system image, by the teams responsible for engineering and implementation.
  • Identify gaps or ambiguity in responsibility between the company and external partners and drive resolution before those gaps create compliance or delivery risk.
  • Recommend program priorities and corrective actions based on FedRAMP requirements, organizational readiness, risk, external dependencies, and authorization objectives
  • Provide FedRAMP subject-matter input to Product, Legal, and other stakeholders, distinguishing documented requirements from partner preferences, interpretation questions, and internal risk decisions.
  • Continuously improve FedRAMP processes, documentation, evidence practices, ownership models, and operating routines to create a sustainable and repeatable compliance program

    • Reporting and Escalation

  • Provide concise, decision-ready reporting to the Director of Security and Compliance on program status, upcoming deadlines, open findings, remediation progress, evidence quality, partner dependencies, and material risks.
  • Escalate early when a missed or threatened deadline, disputed requirement, repeated quality failure, unresolved ownership issue, or external dependency requires management or executive intervention.
  • Clearly identify decisions requiring management, risk-owner, partner, legal, or specialized technical input rather than allowing unresolved issues to delay program execution.
  • Other duties as assigned

• 7+ years of relevant professional experience in security, compliance, technical program management, risk management, cloud security, or related disciplines, including at least 3 years of direct FedRAMP program execution or ownership experience.
  • Demonstrated ownership of a substantial portion of at least one FedRAMP authorization lifecycle, including activities such as readiness or gap assessment, control implementation and evidence readiness, assessment support, findings or POA&M remediation, authorization activities, and transition into continuous monitoring.
  • Experience operating a FedRAMP program after authorization, including continuous monitoring, recurring evidence collection, remediation deadlines, scope or significant-change considerations, and assessment preparation.
  • Strong working knowledge of NIST SP 800-53 and the FedRAMP Moderate baseline, including the ability to interpret controls, implementation statements, control inheritance, shared responsibility, assessment findings, and evidence requirements.
  • Experience operating within cloud or compliance shared-responsibility models, including identifying control ownership, inherited versus customer responsibilities, evidence dependencies, and gaps between provider and customer obligations.
  • Demonstrated ability to translate FedRAMP requirements into clear, actionable expectations, owners, deadlines, evidence requirements, and acceptance criteria for technical and non-technical teams.
  • Experience evaluating whether evidence and remediation responses adequately address stated control requirements or findings, including the judgment to reject inadequate company submissions before external review.
  • Demonstrated ability to drive remediation and compliance commitments across Software Engineering, Cloud or Platform Engineering, IT, Security, Support, Product, and other teams without direct management authority.
  • Working technical knowledge of SaaS and cloud environments sufficient to understand and discuss identity and access management, CI/CD and deployment paths, vulnerability management, logging and monitoring, system boundaries, encryption, change management, software dependencies, and cloud infrastructure.
  • Ability to recognize when specialized technical validation is required and engage the appropriate subject-matter experts rather than serving as the hands-on implementer.
  • Demonstrated ability to independently establish program structure, determine required next actions from regulatory and partner requirements, resolve ambiguous ownership, establish priorities and deadlines, and appropriately escalate matters requiring management, risk-owner, partner, or technical-specialist decisions.
  • Experience effectively leveraging AI-enabled tools, automation, or other advanced systems to improve productivity, analysis, and program execution, with demonstrated judgment in validating outputs and determining when human or subject-matter-expert review is required.

What You Will Own
  • Turn partner use cases into bounded, productized integration designs with clear data flows, authentication and authorization models, failure handling, versioning, ownership, and support plans.
  • Build, test, deploy, and maintain Workato recipes, custom connectors, API-based components, data mappings, and reusable integration templates.
  • Partner with engineering quality assurance to take demonstrable integrations to productized ones, including automated tests, data validation, secure credential handling, observability, alerting, deployment practices, and runbooks.
  • Work directly with partner engineering teams to resolve questions about APIs, schemas, authentication, rate limits, version changes, and operational responsibilities.
  • Collaborate with Product and Engineering to identify gaps in Agiloft APIs and platform capabilities, then translate recurring partner needs into clear product requirements.
  • Support selected sales opportunities by scoping requirements, validating feasibility, and building targeted demos or proofs of concept, with a focus on reusable partner capabilities rather than one-off implementations, and hand-off to Solution Engineering partners to scale demo ability.
  • Use AI coding and agent tools to accelerate API discovery, solution design, data mapping, custom logic, test creation, troubleshooting, and documentation. Review and validate all AI-assisted output before it is used in production.
  • Evaluate MCP and other agent-to-system integration patterns when they fit the use case, with appropriate identity, access control, auditability, and operational safeguards.
  • Provide escalation support for the integrations you own and create the documentation and runbooks that enable support teams to handle routine operations.
    • What Success Looks Like
  • Priority partner integrations move from discovery to supported production releases with clear scope, ownership, and technical documentation.
  • Reusable connectors and patterns reduce duplicate work and shorten delivery time for future integrations.
  • Production integrations are secure, observable, and maintainable, with predictable failure handling and effective operational handoffs.
  • Alliances, Product, and Solution Consulting receive timely, technically sound guidance on partner opportunities and constraints.
  • AI-assisted methods shorten discovery, build, test, and troubleshooting cycles without lowering quality or increasing support burden.
  • Other duties as assigned
    •

No candidate will have used every product or protocol named in this description. We care most about depth in integration engineering, partner-facing judgment, and the ability to learn unfamiliar systems quickly.

  • Five or more years of experience designing, building, and operating production integrations across enterprise systems.
  • Strong hands-on experience with Workato or a comparable enterprise iPaaS, including building, deploying, monitoring, and supporting production workflows. Candidates with MuleSoft, Boomi, Tray.ai, Celigo, or similar experience will be considered if they can become productive in Workato quickly.
  • Deep practical experience with REST APIs, webhooks, JSON, pagination, rate limits, API versioning, error handling, and identity and access patterns such as OAuth 2.0, OIDC, signed JWTs, and API keys.
  • Production experience integrating at least one enterprise platform such as Salesforce, SAP, Coupa, NetSuite, Workday, DocuSign, or a comparable CRM, ERP, procurement, or e-signature system.
  • Ability to write and review custom integration logic in at least one language such as Python, JavaScript, TypeScript, Ruby, or Java.
  • Experience across the integration lifecycle, from requirements and technical design through automated testing, deployment, monitoring, incident response, and change management.
  • Strong partner or customer-facing communication skills, including the ability to explain tradeoffs, set technical boundaries, and turn business needs into implementable designs.
  • Demonstrated expert-level use of AI coding and agent tools in day-to-day engineering. You can explain specific workflows that improve speed and quality, how you verify AI-generated output, and how you protect confidential data and credentials
    •

• Deep Workato experience with custom connectors, environment management, deployment practices, monitoring, and platform governance, including Workato certifications.
  • Experience building productized partner or embedded integrations that are reused across multiple customers.
  • Experience in CLM, legal technology, source-to-pay, procurement, or adjacent enterprise application ecosystems.
  • Experience with event-driven or pub-sub integration patterns and cloud-native or serverless services.
  • Experience building or governing MCP servers, MCP clients, or other agent tool integrations with identity-aware access and audit controls.

lists.content:
What You'll Own

Integration Hub Strategy & Roadmap
  • Define and drive the multi-quarter roadmap for Agiloft's Integration Hub, aligning feature investment to customer needs, competitive positioning, and platform scalability.
  • Set clear priorities across connector ecosystem, task/consumption management, monitoring, and enterprise-grade reliability.
    • API Strategy
  • Own Agiloft's external API surface — versioning, developer experience and authentication patterns.
  • Define standards for how the platform exposes data and actions, enabling both integration partners and enterprise customers to build reliably on top of Agiloft.
    • MCP & AI Orchestration
  • Lead product strategy for Model Context Protocol and AI-driven orchestration capabilities, enabling Agiloft's AI features to connect intelligently with external systems and agents.
  • Define how Agiloft becomes a first-class participant in the emerging AI agent ecosystem.
    • Orchestration Layer
  • Define how Agiloft enables customers to design, deploy, and manage multi-step, multi-system workflows — across integration hub and the Agiloft MCP.
  • Drive toward a platform that supports event-driven, low-latency, and high-reliability automation patterns at enterprise scale.
    • Cross-functional Leadership
  • Partner with engineering, design, CS, sales, and legal tech partners to translate market needs into shipped, high-quality capabilities.
  • Serve as the connective tissue between product, field, and technical teams — ensuring the roadmap is grounded in both strategy and execution reality.
    • Market & Customer Feedback Loops
  • Synthesize customer data, analyst input, competitive signals, and field feedback into prioritized, differentiated product strategy.
  • Establish a continuous discovery cadence with CS, sales, and key customers to keep roadmap decisions grounded in real-world usage.
    • Platform Standards & Scalability
  • Define integration architecture standards, consumption models, and platform health metrics that guide both product investment and customer success motions.
  • Partner with engineering to establish the technical guardrails that make Agiloft integrations stable, observable, and scalable at enterprise scale.
    • Performance Metrics
  • Roadmap execution – What percentage of roadmap items are delivered on time.
  • Platform adoption: Integration Hub management, enabling product owners to achieve activation and usage growth across the customer base
  • Strategic impact: Contribution to competitive positioning in CLM integrations — analyst recognition, win/loss signals, expansion ARR tied to integrations
  • AI/MCP readiness: Shipped MCP capabilities enabling Agiloft's AI agents to connect with and orchestrate external tools

• 5–8 years of product management experience, with at least 2 years owning an integration, API, or platform product
  • Strong command of REST API design, integration architecture patterns, and developer experience principles
  • Demonstrated ability to own a multi-quarter roadmap and drive execution across engineering and cross-functional teams
  • Experience working with iPaaS, workflow automation, API gateway, or middleware technologies
  • Ability to translate complex technical concepts into clear product requirements and measurable customer value
  • Strong communicator who can influence without authority across engineering, CS, sales, and leadership
  • Comfortable operating in a fast-moving, remote environment with multiple concurrent workstreams

• Experience with MCP (Model Context Protocol) or AI agent tooling, orchestration frameworks, or LLM integrations
  • Familiarity with Workato, MuleSoft, Boomi, Tray, or comparable iPaaS platforms
  • Background in CLM, legal tech, ERP, CRM, or enterprise SaaS integrations
  • Experience defining API-first product strategy and developer enablement programs
  • Exposure to event-driven architecture, webhooks, async integration patterns, and consumption-based platform models
  • Experience partnering with OEM or embedded integration providers
  • Background in platform product management, developer tools, or technical ecosystem programs

• Strategic thinker who can zoom out to set direction and zoom in to unblock engineering
  • Technically fluent without needing to own the code — comfortable going deep on architecture, APIs, and data models
  • Driven by platform outcomes — adoption, reliability, extensibility — not just feature launch counts
  • Builds momentum through clarity: crisp PRDs, decisive prioritization, and decisions that hold under pressure
  • Able to distinguish between tactical customer requests and strategic platform investments
  • Focused on building repeatable, scalable platform capabilities — not solving one-off problems
    • In Your First 6 Months
  • Deep-dive on Integration Hub: customers, usage patterns, pain points, and competitive gaps and set a Product Owner up for success.
  • Take on the current MCP roadmap and continue to refine and deliver MCP features.
  • Define the MCP strategy: what Agiloft ships, how it connects with AI agents, and what the go-forward architecture looks like
  • Establish a feedback loop with CS, sales, and key customers to keep the roadmap grounded in real usage
  • Ship at least one meaningful integration platform improvement with measurable customer impact
  • Align with engineering on scalable integration architecture standards that guide both build decisions and customer success motions

We support multiple Employee Resource Groups (ERGs), and offer a working environment that supports healthy work/life balance, including floating holidays and a quarterly, no-questions-asked wellness day.


Position Overview
Decision making in contract technology is shifting. Procurement, CFOs, and CIOs are gaining influence alongside Legal, and they expect contracting outcomes they can measure that are directly connected to company level business strategy. Agiloft has built deep strength with legal personas that will be extended into procurement through additional investments in our products.
As Senior Product Manager for Procurement, you will accelerate the development of procurement-focused contracting motions on our platform. You will identify the highest value procurement scenarios, prioritize for emerging customer demand, and turn them into a roadmap Product builds against.
This is a high-agency, high-accountability product and business building role reporting directly to the Chief Product Officer. You will create and prove value for procurement customers in close partnership with the teams building our core platform and our connected, third-party experiences and generate the evidence that shapes further investment in this motion.

Lead Product Strategy

  • Define and prioritize the procurement use cases with the clearest path to customer value building upon Agiloft's advanced and growing contracting platform.
  • Own a roadmap spanning new capabilities, existing platform features, and integrations.
  • Give particular attention to headless experiences and workflows orchestrated by AI agents.
  • Ensure delivery of critical procurement product roadmap items in partnership with engineering.
  • Partner with engineering and design to deliver the roadmap, and establish success measures such as shorter cycle times, identified savings, and adoption of automated recommendations.
  • Project Agiloft's contract technology core into a procurement-facing value story, building upon and extending the strengths of the existing product stack.
  • Track evidence from customer engagement and use it to shape investment.
  • Translate platform capabilities into a clear procurement value proposition, using customer evidence to guide investment, pricing, and monetization decisions.
  • Represent the product strategy in customer conversations, webinars, conferences, and other relevant industry forums.

    • Customer Evidence and Internal Proof

  • Partner with Agiloft’s finance team as an internal procurement customer to test and improve the experience.
  • Recruit procurement, finance, and operations customers to shape the roadmap, participate in early releases, and become references for the emerging offering.

    • Cross-Functional Product Leadership

  • Partner with existing product teams to build procurement capabilities as an extension of existing platform.
  • Work with product strategy to define procurement-focused trust and governance scenarios.
  • Partner with go-to-market to develop packaging, pricing, and launch plans for procurement scenarios.
  • Co-develop procurement personas and positioning with marketing.
  • Partner with sales enablement, product marketing, and others functions to act as a subject matter expert who educates internal stakeholders on procurement related to their job function.
  • Partner with sales to build a scalable customer engagement motion for procurement.
  • Support partnerships and technology integrations that expand procurement capabilities; share demand signals with professional services to inform its offerings.
  • Other duties as assigned

• 7 or more years of combined experience in enterprise B2B SaaS, including ownership of a product area end to end, and technical development, consulting, customer success, and other directly relevant experience with procurement, source-to-pay, or supplier management workflows and systems, such as SAP Ariba, Coupa, or similar platforms.
  • Demonstrated success building a new product motion or persona from early evidence, with a limited team and evolving resourcing.
  • Experience defining and prioritizing scenarios based on customer value and measurable business outcomes.
  • Strong understanding of API, headless, and orchestration concepts, and how they apply to connected workflows.
  • Experience defining measurable success criteria for AI-driven or automated workflows, such as time saved, cost avoided, or adoption of recommended actions.
  • Experience partnering with cross-functional teams, including engineering, design, and go-to-market, without direct authority over them.
  • Ability to define clear objectives and success criteria for ambiguous, cross-functional initiatives, and align stakeholders who do not report to you around them.
  • Experience making an ROI case for economic buyers, including CFOs or CIOs, and communicating product direction to customers and internal teams.
  • Hands-on use of AI tools to improve how you work and deliver business results.

• Experience with contract lifecycle management, legal technology, or adjacent enterprise workflow platforms.
  • Direct experience working in procurement or sourcing.
  • Experience with the Model Context Protocol, agentic workflows, or AI-driven orchestration.
  • Experience developing packaging and pricing models for new product motions.
  • Experience connecting products into major ecosystems such as SAP.

lists.content:
DATA MODEL & PLATFORM ARCHITECTURE

  • Own the canonical data models and service boundaries in your domain
  • Design models and boundaries that let independent systems evolve in parallel without duplicating logic or creating competing implementations
  • Evolve the platform through additive, backward-compatible changes that introduce new capabilities without disrupting existing behavior.
  • Own the architecture of one or more critical platform domains, with responsibility for design integrity, scalability, reliability, security, and long-term technical health.

    • DISTRIBUTED SYSTEMS & CLOUD ARCHITECTURE (AWS)

  • Design AWS-native, event-driven and asynchronous services that scale on demand, degrade gracefully under load, and remain cost-efficient as volume grows.
  • Architect the backend to enable and support AI/ML workloads at scale with a focus on performance, scalability and cost efficiency.
  • Act as architectural steward for these services, keeping them scalable, resilient, secure, and maintainable as customer and platform demands grow.
  • Drive cloud-native design principles: stateless services, managed-service adoption, and failure-tolerant, self-healing architectures.

    • SECURITY & MULTI-TENANCY

  • Treat tenant isolation, authentication, and authorization as first-class design concerns across every service and API you own.
  • Design secure authentication and token-handling flows, permission-aware data access, and safe credential management for an enterprise, multi-tenant platform.
  • Design for correct, isolated behavior across tenant, environment, and data-residency boundaries, and reason explicitly about security posture and blast radius when centralizing sensitive capabilities.

    • TECHNICAL LEADERSHIP & CROSS-FUNCTIONAL INFLUENCE

  • Partner with product- and engineering leaders to develop a deep understanding of customer and business needs and translate them into platform architectures that solve the problem
  • Lead the technical design of major platform initiatives end to end, and drive alignment across teams and functions whose priorities and incentives do not always converge.
  • Integrate diverse stakeholders and project teams around a shared technical direction, navigating differing functional interests with sound judgment and strong interpersonal skill.
  • Produce clear, rigorous design documents, service contracts, and acceptance criteria that others can review, build on, and trust, setting the standard for technical design on the team.
  • Use AI-assisted tools to accelerate and sharpen design and implementation, applying the judgment to know where they add leverage and where deeper thinking is required.
  • Lead by example in applying AI-assisted engineering tools to accelerate architecture, design, implementation, and testing, using sound technical judgment to amplify productivity without compromising quality, maintainability, or depth of thinking.

    • API DESIGN

  • Design clean, versioned API contracts on top of the platform's data models — including high-scale bulk and asynchronous operations — with deterministic behavior, idempotency, structured error handling, and well-defined limits.
  • Establish contract tests and permission-enforcement validation as first-class parts of every API you design.

    • DELIVERY & ENGINEERING EXCELLENCE

  • Own initiatives end to end from design through release, with accountability for product quality in your domain and high standards for reliability, security, observability, performance, scalability, usability, and cost across the services you own
  • Champion modern practices: infrastructure-as-code, automated testing, continuous delivery, and observability-by-default
  • Lead platform-modernization and refactoring initiatives while maintaining delivery velocity and improve the developer experience for the services you own.
  • Identify and drive improvements to how the engineering organization designs and delivers
  • Contribute across the stack when an initiative calls for it, including UI layers on top of the platform services you build; backend remains the primary focus.

    • ORGANIZATIONAL IMPACT & MENTORSHIP

  • Serve as a technical multiplier unblocking teams, accelerating architectural decisions, and reducing long-term complexity.
  • Partner with CloudOps, Security, MLOps, and integration teams to define reliability targets, operational-readiness standards, and clean interfaces between domains.
  • Mentor senior and mid-level engineers, raising the bar for data-model and systems design, security, and design-document quality.
  • Stay ahead of a fast-moving industry, particularly the rapid evolution of AI capabilities, and drive pragmatic adoption where it delivers clear business value.
  • Other duties as assigned.

    •

• Bachelor's and/or master's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Software or Electrical/Electronics Engineering, or a comparable field.
  • 8+ years of professional software engineering experience, including 2+ years at staff level.
  • Demonstrated leadership of architecture decisions spanning multiple teams with concrete examples of driving cross-team technical direction to a decision.
  • Proven ability to drive technical outcomes across diverse stakeholders and teams that report into different functions, aligning divergent interests without direct authority.
  • Track record of owning significant initiatives end to end, including release ownership.
  • Strong proficiency in Python (working experience in Java a plus), building backend and cloud-based services.
  • Deep experience designing, building, and operating scalable, enterprise-grade distributed systems on AWS.
  • Strong data-modeling and service-architecture skills, with a track record of building durable, reusable abstractions that other teams adopt and extend without rework.
  • Experience designing backend systems that enable demanding workloads wih high-throughput data pipelines, asynchronous processing, or ML/inference services at scale and with cost-efficiently.
  • Solid grounding in application security and multi-tenancy: authentication/authorization, token handling, tenant isolation, and permission-aware data access.
  • Experience designing high-scale API contracts
  • Strong experience with infrastructure-as-code and CI/CD for cloud services.
  • Strong understanding of observability in distributed systems: logging, metrics, tracing, and alerting.
  • A demonstrated habit of staying current with rapidly evolving AI capabilities and integrating them into how you work and design.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication in English

Additional Experience (a plus)

  • Building services that support AI/ML product features and data pipelines
  • Integrating third-party SaaS platforms and connectors with attention to security and reliability.
  • Search and retrieval systems
  • Domain familiarity with CLM, contracts, or comparable enterprise B2B platforms.

lists.content:
DATA MODEL & PLATFORM ARCHITECTURE

  • Own the canonical data models and service boundaries in your domain
  • Design models and boundaries that let independent systems evolve in parallel without duplicating logic or creating competing implementations
  • Evolve the platform through additive, backward-compatible changes that introduce new capabilities without disrupting existing behavior.
  • Own the architecture of one or more critical platform domains, with responsibility for design integrity, scalability, reliability, security, and long-term technical health.

    • DISTRIBUTED SYSTEMS & CLOUD ARCHITECTURE (AWS)

  • Design AWS-native, event-driven and asynchronous services that scale on demand, degrade gracefully under load, and remain cost-efficient as volume grows.
  • Architect the backend to enable and support AI/ML workloads at scale with a focus on performance, scalability and cost efficiency.
  • Act as architectural steward for these services, keeping them scalable, resilient, secure, and maintainable as customer and platform demands grow.
  • Drive cloud-native design principles: stateless services, managed-service adoption, and failure-tolerant, self-healing architectures.

    • SECURITY & MULTI-TENANCY

  • Treat tenant isolation, authentication, and authorization as first-class design concerns across every service and API you own.
  • Design secure authentication and token-handling flows, permission-aware data access, and safe credential management for an enterprise, multi-tenant platform.
  • Design for correct, isolated behavior across tenant, environment, and data-residency boundaries, and reason explicitly about security posture and blast radius when centralizing sensitive capabilities.

    • TECHNICAL LEADERSHIP & CROSS-FUNCTIONAL INFLUENCE

  • Partner with product- and engineering leaders to develop a deep understanding of customer and business needs and translate them into platform architectures that solve the problem
  • Lead the technical design of major platform initiatives end to end, and drive alignment across teams and functions whose priorities and incentives do not always converge.
  • Integrate diverse stakeholders and project teams around a shared technical direction, navigating differing functional interests with sound judgment and strong interpersonal skill.
  • Produce clear, rigorous design documents, service contracts, and acceptance criteria that others can review, build on, and trust, setting the standard for technical design on the team.
  • Use AI-assisted tools to accelerate and sharpen design and implementation, applying the judgment to know where they add leverage and where deeper thinking is required.
  • Lead by example in applying AI-assisted engineering tools to accelerate architecture, design, implementation, and testing, using sound technical judgment to amplify productivity without compromising quality, maintainability, or depth of thinking.

    • API DESIGN

  • Design clean, versioned API contracts on top of the platform's data models — including high-scale bulk and asynchronous operations — with deterministic behavior, idempotency, structured error handling, and well-defined limits.
  • Establish contract tests and permission-enforcement validation as first-class parts of every API you design.

    • DELIVERY & ENGINEERING EXCELLENCE

  • Own initiatives end to end from design through release, with accountability for product quality in your domain and high standards for reliability, security, observability, performance, scalability, usability, and cost across the services you own
  • Champion modern practices: infrastructure-as-code, automated testing, continuous delivery, and observability-by-default
  • Lead platform-modernization and refactoring initiatives while maintaining delivery velocity and improve the developer experience for the services you own.
  • Identify and drive improvements to how the engineering organization designs and delivers
  • Contribute across the stack when an initiative calls for it, including UI layers on top of the platform services you build; backend remains the primary focus.

    • ORGANIZATIONAL IMPACT & MENTORSHIP

  • Serve as a technical multiplier unblocking teams, accelerating architectural decisions, and reducing long-term complexity.
  • Partner with CloudOps, Security, MLOps, and integration teams to define reliability targets, operational-readiness standards, and clean interfaces between domains.
  • Mentor senior and mid-level engineers, raising the bar for data-model and systems design, security, and design-document quality.
  • Stay ahead of a fast-moving industry, particularly the rapid evolution of AI capabilities, and drive pragmatic adoption where it delivers clear business value.
  • Other duties as assigned.

    •

• Bachelor's and/or master's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Software or Electrical/Electronics Engineering, or a comparable field.
  • 8+ years of professional software engineering experience, including 2+ years at staff level.
  • Demonstrated leadership of architecture decisions spanning multiple teams with concrete examples of driving cross-team technical direction to a decision.
  • Proven ability to drive technical outcomes across diverse stakeholders and teams that report into different functions, aligning divergent interests without direct authority.
  • Track record of owning significant initiatives end to end, including release ownership.
  • Strong proficiency in Python (working experience in Java a plus), building backend and cloud-based services.
  • Deep experience designing, building, and operating scalable, enterprise-grade distributed systems on AWS.
  • Strong data-modeling and service-architecture skills, with a track record of building durable, reusable abstractions that other teams adopt and extend without rework.
  • Experience designing backend systems that enable demanding workloads wih high-throughput data pipelines, asynchronous processing, or ML/inference services at scale and with cost-efficiently.
  • Solid grounding in application security and multi-tenancy: authentication/authorization, token handling, tenant isolation, and permission-aware data access.
  • Experience designing high-scale API contracts
  • Strong experience with infrastructure-as-code and CI/CD for cloud services.
  • Strong understanding of observability in distributed systems: logging, metrics, tracing, and alerting.
  • A demonstrated habit of staying current with rapidly evolving AI capabilities and integrating them into how you work and design.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication in English

Additional Experience (a plus)

  • Building services that support AI/ML product features and data pipelines
  • Integrating third-party SaaS platforms and connectors with attention to security and reliability.
  • Search and retrieval systems
  • Domain familiarity with CLM, contracts, or comparable enterprise B2B platforms.
